title: REQ · effectContext createEffect returns on every path
description: createEffect in game/frontend/src/phaser/effectContext.ts switches on spec.type but tsc reports TS2366 because no return follows the switch. Make the switch exhaustive with a never check so every path returns an EffectHandle.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dust, ambientLight or transition spec, when createEffect runs, then it returns a handle with destroy
Given an unknown spec type, when createEffect runs, then it throws an error naming the type

preserve: Existing dust, ambientLight and transition behavior
